trust_decision.summary: The image 'label' property (attacker-influenced: read from input files or set with -label) is treated as inert text when the writers splice it into generated PostScript/PDF programs. At the pinned commit each writer splits it into lines and emits each line raw, with no escaping.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'PostScript Coders'. coders/ps.c is the primary PS writer, and the raw '%s \n' label emit there is the first label sink in WritePSImage.

fix_sites.entry_point: WriteImage / CLI `magick ... out.ps3|eps3` (WritePS3Image); compressed raw branch and NoCompression Ascii85 branch
WriteImage / CLI `magick ... out.pdf|epdf|pdfa` (WritePDFImage) content stream '(%s) Tj'
fix_sites.module_kind: coder (PDF writer, different output format, follow-up commit)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: coders/pdf.c:1918 (PDF content-stream text operator, fixed only in follow-up commit 2ba2edf, fix.diff:132-157)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names the 'PostScript coders'. PDF is a different format with its own writer, and its PDF/A metadata path already escapes (coders/pdf.c:1275-1284), so a solver can treat PDF as already covered or out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate labels that contain parentheses or backslashes, and multi-line labels, must still render as label text: one line per label line, matching the readline count computed from MultilineCensus. An over-broad fix breaks this by stripping or rejecting '(' ')' '\\', by dropping labels, or by changing the line split.

O6_input_shapes: multi-line label split by StringToList into several emitted lines
PS3 compressed (raw byte) branch vs NoCompression Ascii85 branch
PDF '(%s) Tj' string-literal context vs PS line-data context

O7_producer.where: MagickCore/string.c:2349-2372 (StringToStrings switches to a hex-dump list with CharsPerLine chunks when a control char is present, MagickCore/string.c:2428-2475), while the prolog's readline count comes from MultilineCensus counting '\n' (MagickCore/utility.c:1988-1990)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Font name with '^' prefix (from -font or the MVG/SVG 'font' keyword) is interpolated raw into the PostScript program that RenderPostscript builds and hands to Ghostscript; only draw_info->text is escaped.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a font name in the text renderer in MagickCore, not a label in a PS coder, and the adjacent text is already escaped (MagickCore/annotate.c:2295), so it looks handled.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different directory/library (MagickCore vs coders); reached via MagickCore/annotate.c:1017-1018 and MagickCore/draw.c:3073-3076

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Label line-count differential: when the label holds a control character, StringToStrings emits hex-dump lines (which still carry the label's printable chars) whose count differs from the MultilineCensus readline count in the PS/PS2/PS3 prolog, so surplus emitted lines are no longer consumed as data. EscapeParenthesis does not address this.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Control-character labels look like an edge case, and the hex dump is an intentional legitimate formatting of StringToList.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: MagickCore/string.c and MagickCore/utility.c:1988-1990, consumed in coders/ps.c:1803 and coders/ps2.c:731 and coders/ps3.c:1184

O8b_injection_room.sibling: %%Title built from an image property (e.g. 'comment' or 'caption') without FilenameToTitle.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The title is already spliced as '(%s)'. A maintainer adding 'use the image title if set' would plausibly skip the filename sanitiser.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: /CreationDate or /ModDate taken from a user option or date property and written as '(%s)'.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same '(%s)' literal pattern is used. Honouring a user-supplied date option is a natural feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Non-PDF/A WritePDFValue fallback that writes the value raw as '(%s)' when UTF-16 conversion fails.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The current code silently skips on conversion failure. A 'write it anyway' fallback is a plausible maintenance change.

O9_family: code injection (CWE-94): unescaped user text spliced into generated PostScript/PDF program text interpreted by Ghostscript/PDF readers

O10_build.toolchain: autotools (configure/make) with gcc/clang; Ghostscript optional, needed only to render the PS output, not to inspect it
O10_build.project_tests: unknown: no tests are added or changed in the fix diff, and no PS/PDF label tests were located (Magick++/tests has no PS/PDF match)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap the label in EscapeParenthesis in coders/ps.c only, or in the three PS writers only, leaving pdf.c, the line-count mapper and the annotate font path untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: coders/ps3.c:1244-1247 writes the 8BIM clip-path property raw into the PS output. It is produced internally from path data, not checked further.
Older GHSA-vcjj-32hg-qpx5 and GHSA-6xf5-c3jx-rp39 fixes sit in the recent history at the pinned commit. They are unrelated to this advisory.
unverified: The O8 line-count differential route was found by reading only. The PostScript interpretation of surplus lines was not executed.

In PS/PS2 the label is consumed via 'readline' (coders/ps.c:1805-1809), which does not unescape. EscapeParenthesis there may show literal backslashes, and its protective effect in that context is unclear. In the PS3 compressed branch the line is parsed by 'token' (coders/ps3.c:1187). Hidden-test design should confirm what the 'legitimate label' expectation is.
Reachability of RenderPostscript under the default policy and the Ghostscript -dSAFER settings was not checked.
